Raingentic Commerce Hackathon NYC
description: Two-day in-person hackathon in New York for senior engineers building agentic commerce use cases with Rain's stablecoin payments platform. Build practical prototypes with Rain's infrastructure, get direct access to the Rain team, investor speakers from Dragonfly and FirstMark, and technical mentorship throughout the weekend.
prize_note: Michelin Star Dinner with Rain Founders

name: Replit Buildathon
description: Build a fully functioning, shareable app template in Replit across six categories: business tools, data dashboards, marketing sites, commerce, AI agent apps, and design systems. Apps must be rich and interactive, connected to real integrations, well-designed with polished UI, and genuinely useful enough for others to remix. Top 3 winners take $1,000 each.

name: Solana Blitz V7: Collaboration
description: Week-long hackathon building collaborative Solana experiences using MagicBlock's Ephemeral Rollup. Theme is Collaboration — build real-time multiplayer apps, shared onchain state, or co-op gaming mechanics. Every submission must integrate MagicBlock's Ephemeral Rollup. Wizardio's Choice award ($100 USDC) goes to the best build from a team formed during the event.

name: Cleanverse Build: Trusted Assets Hackathon
description: Build compliant Web3 applications using Cleanverse Verified Identity (CVI) and Cleanverse Verified Assets (CVA) across two tracks: RWA (real-world asset tokenization with embedded compliance) and DeFi (gated lending pools, identity-based lending, permissioned staking). Build on any integrated chain including Monad, Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, and BNB Chain.

name: NoahAI Nitro 01: Solana Gaming
description: Six-day building sprint using NoahAI to create new gaming experiences on Solana through prompts. Build mobile games, onchain mechanics, leaderboards, tournaments, quests, rewards, or player identity systems. No advanced coding experience required — solo or team entry welcome.

name: KeeperHub Agents Onchain Hackathon
description: Build an AI agent that executes real transactions onchain through KeeperHub, the execution and reliability layer for agent infrastructure. Use any agent framework — ElizaOS, CrewAI, LangChain, or your own — and let KeeperHub handle gas estimation, MEV protection, and audit trails. Judging weighs real onchain execution heavily.

name: Flare Summer Signal Hackathon
description: Open online hackathon for building real products on Flare across two bounties: interoperable asset products (DeFi, XRP, FAssets) and private applications using Flare Confidential Compute. Existing projects welcome — teams must clearly separate what was newly built during the hackathon. Judged on product usefulness and Flare integration quality.

name: Aleo x OpenBuild Hackathon
description: APAC-focused hackathon building programmable privacy applications on Aleo, a ZK-powered Layer 1. Five tracks: AI x Privacy, Private Payments, Privacy DeFi, Developer Infrastructure, and GameFi & SocialFi. One winning project per track earns $1,000. Top projects get ecosystem support and incubation opportunities.

name: Build for a Cooler Future Hackathon
description: Global AI hackathon building climate tech using FortyGuard's NVIDIA-recognized Temperature API — hyperlocal urban temperature intelligence measured 2 meters above ground. Seven challenge tracks including Resilient Cities, Future Buildings and Energy, Agentic AI, and Data Analysis. Free API access and trial credits provided to all participants.

name: OKX AI Trading Hackathon
description: Build AI-powered trading strategies and algorithms using OKX's trading APIs and data infrastructure. Compete across tracks covering quantitative strategies, AI trading agents, and market-making bots. Judged on strategy performance, risk management, innovation, and technical execution.

name: Arkiv Network Ideathon
description: Submit a business idea or use case built on Arkiv Network — a decentralized data storage and provenance layer. No coding required for the ideathon phase. Top ideas move into a funded build phase with technical support from the Arkiv team. Judged on originality, feasibility, and ecosystem fit.

name: BOT Chain Builder Challenge #2: AI × RWA
description: Global online builder challenge for AI Native Applications and RWA Applications on BOT Chain Mainnet. Two tracks: RWA Applications and AI Native Applications. Outstanding projects get mainnet gas support, BOT Labs incubation opportunities, ecosystem grant access, and global conference recommendations beyond the cash prize.

name: AI Season Hackathon
description: Build AI and Web3 applications on X Layer combining AI capabilities with onchain value. Three prize tiers: Hackathon Grant (top 3 projects share $50K), Liquidity Grant ($50K for best AI-RWA track project), and Launch Grant (up to $200K unlocked by cumulative OKX DEX trading volume). Must deploy on X Layer Testnet during the hackathon then launch on Mainnet.

name: 0G Bridge Buildathon by AKINDO
description: Ten-week, 5-wave buildathon for shipping AI x Web3 applications on 0G — a decentralized AI Layer 1 with modular compute, storage, and data availability infrastructure. Credits distributed wave-by-wave based on real progress from prototype to mainnet. Top teams pitch at Demo Day during Token2049 Singapore.

name: Wearable AI Workshop @ ICCV 2026
description: Academic workshop and challenge on wearable AI at ICCV 2026 in Honolulu. Two tracks: Egocentric Action Recognition (first-person video understanding from wearable cameras) and Multimodal Sensing (combining vision, IMU, audio, and physiological signals). Submit a research paper or technical report alongside your model. Top submissions present at the workshop.

name: Blueprint Summer 2026 Build Contest
description: Design any hardware project using Blueprint, build it for under $250, and share a 10–20 second demo video on Instagram, TikTok, or X. Judged on originality, creativity, and presentation. Top prizes include Bambu Lab 3D printers and Nvidia Jetson / Raspberry Pi compute boards.

name: The Great Agent Hackathon
description: Two-stage enterprise AI agent hackathon. Online qualification round requires a Figma prototype or working demo across three tracks: Customer and Employee Experience (Freshworks Agent Studio and MCP), Platform Agent Skills (reusable skills and MCP integrations), and AI-native Enterprise (open stack). Shortlisted teams travel to Bangalore for a 24-hour overnight build and live Main Stage finale at India's largest product conference.

name: Delphi Agent Competition
description: Build an AI agent powered by a Delphi Mind — a digital clone trained on a real expert's knowledge. Agents must use the Delphi API to access expert knowledge bases and deliver value in a specific domain. Judged on real-world utility, quality of Delphi integration, and innovation. Every valid submission receives free Delphi API credits.

name: .hack '26
description: Thirty-six hour hackathon for hardware and software solutions tackling real-world challenges. Seventh edition of the flagship IEEE student event, featuring keynote talks, networking, and evaluation by industry professionals. Open to students across diverse disciplines building for social impact.

name: Telegraph Hackathon Season I
description: Three-track hackathon on Telegraph Protocol built on Base. Submit Miners (APIs, models, datasets, or tools), evaluation scripts that rank Miner quality, or applications built on top of live Miners. Part of a 3-hackathon series — Hackathon 1 runs August 17 to September 7, followed by two more rounds through December.

name: Pokémon TCG AI Battle Challenge: Strategy
description: Analyze and document the strategy behind your AI Training Agent for the Pokémon Trading Card Game. Explain deck construction choices, hypotheses tested, and strategic reasoning. Judged on model performance, deck design quality, and report clarity. Must also enter the Simulation Category to be eligible. Top 8 finalists may be invited to an in-person tournament in Tokyo.

name: XRPL Make Waves
description: Three-month challenge to build a real-world application on XRPL Mainnet, attract users, and generate on-chain volume. Weekly leaderboard tracks progress. Prize categories reward most users, highest volume, hitting 300 active users, and a jury grand prize for best overall project. Top projects can enter the Aquarium incubator.

name: BUIDL CTC 2026 Fall
description: Multi-track Web3 hackathon covering DeFi, NFTs, DAOs, gaming, and infrastructure. Build production-ready dApps with real users and on-chain activity. Judged on technical execution, innovation, and ecosystem impact. Part of the ongoing CTC builder series with ecosystem support and mentorship from Web3 protocols.

name: Algorand Global x402 Challenge
description: Deploy a paid x402 endpoint on Algorand Mainnet — charge per data request, compute job, action, or verification — and generate real on-chain usage. Top 50 on the leaderboard compete for 10 finalist spots who pitch live at Devcon 8 India. Judged on real usage, use case quality, technical execution, and long-term potential.

name: AI Builder Hackathon 2026
description: Build browser-native AI tools and 3D experiences that transform natural language into interactive worlds. Projects must run in the browser and turn plain language into 3D scenes and working logic. Covers AI-generated 3D scenes, intelligent NPCs, procedural worlds, and real-time AI interactions using any web-based 3D stack.

name: QIE Mainnet Hackathon 3.0
description: Four-month hackathon to build and launch live products on QIE Mainnet — not demos. Five tracks: DeFi, AI and Autonomous Agents, Consumer Apps, Commerce and Real World, and Developer Infrastructure. Prizes split 50% on win and 50% released after hitting 90-day traction milestones covering wallet growth, transaction volume, and revenue.
